"import re
from openpyxl import load_workbook

SRC = "ssb_279_23_init.xlsx"
DST = "output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(SRC)

# Work on Sheet1 (fall back to active sheet if somehow renamed)
if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb["Sheet1"]
else:
    ws = wb.active

# Process all cells in column B within the answer region (rows 3-26),
# which corresponds to iterating over column B without gaps.
for row in range(3, 27):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=2)

    # Never touch formulas (preserve them as-is)
    if cell.data_type == "f":
        continue

    val = cell.value

    # Blank cells stay blank (we simply never write anything, not even 0)
    if val is None:
        continue

    s = str(val)

    # Find the first opening parenthesis
    i = s.find("(")
    if i == -1:
        # No parentheses -> leave the cell exactly as it is
        continue

    # Find the closing parenthesis that completes the first pair
    j = s.find(")", i + 1)
    if j == -1:
        # No complete pair of parentheses -> leave the cell as it is
        continue

    # Keep only the text inside the first complete pair,
    # removing both parentheses and all surrounding text.
    inner = s[i + 1:j]

    if inner == "":
        cell.value = None  # keep truly blank instead of writing an empty string/0
    else:
        cell.value = inner

# Save a copy as output.xlsx, preserving all existing sheets/content
wb.save(DST)"
